description: Gets the last context switch (or context return) entry: type, fromBot, fromProduct, toBot, toProduct, toState and customData. Project types (fromProduct/toProduct) are JAICP, AGENT or AIMYLOGIC

output.description: The last switch entry, or null if no switch occurred

fromBot.description: Id of the bot the transition came from

fromProduct.description: Project type of the source bot: JAICP, AGENT or AIMYLOGIC

toBot.description: Id of the bot the transition goes to

toProduct.description: Project type of the target bot: JAICP, AGENT or AIMYLOGIC

customData.description: Custom data passed with the switch (only for Agent Platform targets)
